blocks.text: The SEO toolkit trusted by the world's best marketing teams

Ahrefs has built the second-largest web crawler after Google, and this data advantage underpins everything the platform does. Backlink analysis, keyword research, content gap analysis, and competitive intelligence - all powered by a dataset that most competitors cannot match in freshness or completeness.

For content-led growth strategies, Ahrefs' Content Explorer and Keywords Explorer are invaluable. Find topics with high search volume and low competition, analyze what is currently ranking, and identify the backlink profile needed to compete. This data-driven approach to content planning consistently produces better results than guesswork.

The Site Audit feature helps technical SEO teams identify and fix crawlability issues, broken links, redirect chains, and other technical problems that affect search performance. Regular audits catch issues before they impact rankings.
Comprehensive backlink and organic traffic analysis for any domain
Keyword research with difficulty scores, volume, and SERP analysis
Technical SEO crawler that identifies 170+ types of issues
Monitor keyword rankings across desktop and mobile
Find top-performing content by topic with social and link metrics
See competitors' top pages, keywords, and backlink strategies

Ahrefs is the SEO tool we use daily for keyword research, competitive analysis, and backlink monitoring. The data quality and depth of analysis are unmatched for making informed content and SEO decisions.
Our team can integrate Ahrefs into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
